# E0390: a lens takes the first element of a list that may be empty

A lens takes the first element of a list built by a comprehension with no
fallback element. When the condition is false the list is empty and the index
fails. Add a fallback: `[if c {x}, y][0]`.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				n: "a" | "b"
			}
		}
	}
	"1": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				s: string
			}
		}
	}
}
lenses: {
	"0.0->1.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			s: [if input.n == "a" {"x"}][0]
		}
	}
	"1.0->0.0": {
		input: _
		result: {
			n: "a"
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0390]: s in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 is not total for some instance
  --> lineage.cue:22:7
   |
22 |             s: [if input.n == "a" {"x"}][0]
   |                ^
   |
   = note: s in the result of lens 0.0->1.0 takes the first element of a list built by if input.n == "a" with no fallback, so when the condition is false the list is empty and the index fails; add a fallback element: [if c {x}, y][0]
   = note: a lens must be total: every instance of schema 0.0 must translate to an instance of schema 1.0 (totality rule unknown-head)
   = help: write the mapping in a form the checker can follow, or add a lacuna where it cannot decide
```
